_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro: {num_players}-O'yinchi atrofida {width}x{height} grid. Siz o'yinchi {player_id}. Amaldagi harakatlar: "[up]" "[down]" "[left]" "[right]" yoki w / s / a / d. Maqsad: hamma boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq yashang. Yo'llar o'ldiradi; devorga urish o'ldiradi; yuzma-yuz to'qnashuv ikkalasi ham o'ldiradi.

board.after_moves: Bir vaqtning o'zida harakatlardan keyin taxtada: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: O'yinchi {player_id} haqiqiy bo'lmagan harakat tufayli vafot etdi.

outcome.survived_win: O'yinchi {player_id} omon qoldi; qolganlari esa halokatga uchradi.
outcome.all_crashed: Barcha o'yinchilar bir vaqtning o'zida qulab tushishdi.
outcome.outlived: O'yinchi boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq umr ko'rdi.
outcome.turn_limit: To'g'ri chiziq chegarasi yetkazildi - eng uzoq omon qolgan g'olib bo'ladi.
